Consider the arc of the curve y=4−x2 that lies in the first quadrant between the line x=0 and its x-intercept. What integral gives the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
4π∫02x4−x2dx
b
2π∫02x4−x2dx
c
4π∫02(4−x2)4−x2dx
d
4π∫02dx
e
2π∫024−x2dx
